fields.description: A Copilot run starts for every new ticket of a customer with "Copilot enabled"
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Tasks for hand-overs go here when the customer has no project of their own
fields.label: Hand-over Project

fields.description: A worker keeps a run alive by heartbeat; after this long without one the run is given back to the queue
fields.label: Lease Minutes

fields.description: After this many lost leases the run fails and a person is told
fields.label: Max Lease Losses

fields.description: An investigation below this confidence (0 to 1) is treated as unclear
fields.label: Min Confidence

fields.description: TBO staff and the Copilot worker use the hub's MCP server (helpdesk.api.copilot_mcp.handle)
fields.label: MCP Server On

fields.description: Per person; calls over this are refused for the rest of the minute
fields.label: MCP Calls per Minute

fields.description: One row per stage; a missing or empty row uses the built-in text
fields.label: Stage Messages
